top_signals.title: Patagonia CEO: Insist on Growing at Own Pace
top_signals.summary: Patagonia CEO Ryan Gellert, discusses the company’s approach to environmental activism, Gellert’s views on growth and profitability, and where he believes leaders across the industry stand. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Arc’teryx CEO on Product Expansion & Consumer Demand
top_signals.summary: Stuart Haselden CEO of Arc'teryx discusses the company's aims to nearly double revenue over the next five years by building on two strategic priorities. The company has focused on technical innovation and performance products, while divesting lifestyle products it believed diluted its brand authority. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Cuba’s Fuel Crisis Turns the Island Into a Solar Test Case
top_signals.summary: Cuba is turning into a solar-powered island because of the U.S. naval blockade that is preventing fuel from reaching it. Imports of solar tech from that same U.S. are surging despite the decades-old U.S. embargo on Cuba, and strengthening the case for solar energy—in the absence of any alternatives. Bloomberg earlier this week cited U.S. Census data showing that exports of solar cells and modules from the U.S. to Cuba topped $6.3 million over the first seven months of the year.
